rules.statement: Before dismissing a partition action for non-prosecution, the court must compel the parties to bring the action to a termination.
rules.supporting_quote: In terms of the provisions of section 70 of the Partition Law, before dismissing a partition action for non-prosecution, the court has to compel the parties to bring the action to a termination.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 70 of the Partition Law No. 21 of 1997
